newsitem.title: USA: IES 538 MW Iowa power plant in restart.
newsitem.headline: IES 538 MW Iowa power plant in restart.

text.p: IES Utilities Inc's 538 megawatt Duane Arnold nuclear power plant was resuming production and was likely to synchronize to the electricity grid Saturday, a company spokeswoman said.
"The unit is in initial startup," spokeswoman Diane Ramsey said Friday, adding "it will be a week or so before (the plant) is back up to full production."
The Palo, Iowa, unit was shut Oct 11 for 35 days of scheduled refueling and maintenance and was returning to service slightly ahead of original plans, the spokeswoman said.
IES Utilities is a subsidiary of IES Industries Inc.
